How to use

Cube Phonics 2 · Reader 7 — tap a sentence to hear it.

Red ▶
Opens the chant film on YouTube, in a new tab — the same film the QR code in the printed book opens.
Orange ring
The headphone icon — plays the audio only.
Pictures
Tap any picture or word to hear it on its own.
Choices
Tap to circle one. Tap it again to undo.
Answers
Draws the answers in red and fills in the blanks.
Check
Marks each circle you drew right or wrong.
Write
Write straight onto the page with a finger or a pen.
[ ]
Nudges the lyrics by 0.1s if they run ahead of or behind the singing. Your setting is remembered.
Sync
If the words and pictures do not follow the singing, press Sync and tap twice — once on the first line, once on the last. The rest is worked out from those two and remembered.
Zoom
Pinch or double tap the page to look closer, then drag it about. − and + do the same; the % button fits the page again.
← →
Turn the page. A answers, W write, M sound, Space play audio, − + 0 zoom.
